declines.message: water 'down-a-hill-beck' is 3 deep and its carve cut 14 course(s) of ground away above its own line — a straight-sided wall from y16 to y29 at (-1, 11). The line is the lowest surface the body crosses and every column over it is emptied down to it, so a pool drawn across a slope digs a pit as deep as the ground falls. Draw it inside ground that is already level, or state a `level` and let it fill the hollow there is.
